paper_summary: This paper presents Sun-as-a-star analyses of spatially integrated Hα spectra to investigate various solar active events, such as flares, filament eruptions, and off-limb prominence eruptions. The primary dataset is from the Solar Dynamics Doppler Imager (SDDI) on SMART at Hida Observatory, with complementary data from GOES soft X-ray measurements, SOHO/LASCO coronagraph images, and SDO/AIA multi-wavelength imagery. These instruments are used to identify event timing, verify CME occurrence, and interpret event scenarios for events between November 2016 and May 2021.

instruments.name: AIA (Atmospheric Imaging Assembly) on SDO
instruments.general_comments: AIA provides multi-wavelength EUV imagery (e.g., 171 Å and 131 Å) to support event scenario interpretation and complement Hα observations.
general_quotes: In addition to the SDDI data, for some events we used data taken with the Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA; Lemen et al. 2012) on board the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) to ensure the event scenarios.
